definitions.gloss: to copy down; to transcribe; to write out
definitions.explanation: To reproduce text by writing it out by hand, copying from one source to another.

examples.japanese: {黒板|こくばん}の{内容|ないよう}を{書|か}き{写|うつ}す。
examples.english: To copy down what's on the blackboard.

examples.japanese: ノートに{教科書|きょうかしょ}の{文|ぶん}を{書|か}き{写|うつ}した。
examples.english: I copied the sentences from the textbook into my notebook.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{手紙|てがみ}を{丁寧|ていねい}に{書|か}き{写|うつ}して{記録|きろく}に{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: I carefully transcribed the old letters and preserved them as a record.

notes:
A compound godan verb ({書|か}く + {写|うつ}す) meaning to copy text by writing it out. Implies manual handwriting rather than mechanical or digital copying.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒板|こくばん}を{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to copy from the blackboard
- ノートに{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to copy into a notebook
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to carefully transcribe
- {原文|げんぶん}を{書|か}き{写|うつ}す: to copy the original text

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {写|うつ}す: to copy — the base verb; broader meaning including photographing and copying by any means
- {書|か}き{取|と}る: to write down, to take dictation — writing from spoken words rather than from a written source
- {転記|てんき}する: to transcribe, to transfer (data) — more formal; used for transferring information between records or documents
- {模写|もしゃ}する: to copy, to reproduce — used for copying artwork or visual materials, not just text
